title: How to Order Custom Caps from China: Step by Step
h1: How to Order Custom Baseball Caps from a Chinese Factory, Step by Step
description: The full order path from China: quote, free digital proof, sample, 12-18 day production, QC photos, balance, and express, air, or sea shipping to your door.
tldr: A first custom cap order runs about 4-6 weeks door to door: 1-3 days for a quote, 1-2 days for a free proof, 5-7 days for a sample, 12-18 days of production, and 5-8 days by express.
Nothing goes into production until you approve a digital proof and, if you order one, a physical sample.
Payment usually runs as a deposit before production and the balance after QC photos, before the goods ship.
You need five things for an accurate quote: a logo file, Pantone colors, a size breakdown, a ship-to address, and your in-hands date.
Reorders skip artwork and sampling, so they start producing faster and price at the new quantity tier.
intro: Ordering from a Chinese cap factory is a fixed sequence, and most delays come from missing it in the middle: unclear artwork, an unapproved proof, or a balance payment landing while the goods are already packed. This walkthrough covers all ten steps, how long each one takes, what to have ready, and how payment and shipping work.

keyFacts.label: Payment
keyFacts.value: T/T, Trade Assurance, PayPal for samples

sections.h2: How long does a custom cap order take from first email to delivery?

blocks.text: Plan on four to six weeks door to door for a first order: about one week for quote and proof, 5-7 days for a sample if you want one, 12-18 days of bulk production, and 5-8 days of express shipping to the U.S.
Peak season pushes bulk production to 18-25 days, and sea freight adds 30-40 days in transit. Sea freight cuts the cost per cap sharply, so it suits large orders with a comfortable deadline.

sections.h2: What are the steps in a custom cap order?

blocks.text: A custom cap order follows ten steps, and only two of them need your approval: the digital proof and the sample.

items.title: Inquiry and quote
items.text: Send your logo, quantity, colorways, and ship-to address. A quote comes back in 1-3 business days with unit price, setup, and freight.

items.title: Artwork check and free digital proof
items.text: The factory reviews your file and sends a mockup showing logo width in cm, thread colors, and placement. Revisions are free until you approve it.

items.title: Sample approval
items.text: Optional but recommended: 1-2 pcs in 5-7 days. You check fit, fabric, stitch density, and color in daylight.

items.title: Bulk order and deposit
items.text: Confirm quantity, sizes, and colorways, then pay the deposit by T/T or Alibaba Trade Assurance to book a production slot.

items.title: Production, 12-18 days
items.text: Fabric is cut, panels are embroidered, and caps are sewn, trimmed, and pressed. Peak season runs 18-25 days.

items.title: QC and photos
items.text: The factory inspects stitch quality, logo size, color match, and size counts, then sends photos before packing.

items.title: Balance payment
items.text: You pay the balance once you approve the QC photos and before the goods leave the factory.

items.title: Shipping
items.text: Express 5-8 days, air 8-12 days, or sea 30-40 days to the U.S. DDP door delivery is available.

items.title: Delivery and count check
items.text: Check carton count, size breakdown, and a few caps against the approved sample as soon as the shipment lands.

items.title: Reorder
items.text: Send the original order number or artwork. The file and thread colors are already on record.

sections.h2: What does the timeline look like stage by stage?

blocks.text: The production clock starts when the deposit clears, not when you first email. Working backward from your in-hands date is the only reliable way to know which shipping method still fits.

What happens

sections.h2: What should you have ready before you ask for a quote?

blocks.text: Five things get you an accurate quote in the first reply: a logo file, Pantone colors, a size breakdown, a ship-to address, and your deadline.

head: What to send
Format or detail
Why it matters
rows: Vector .ai, .eps, .pdf, or .svg; a 300 dpi .png as backup
Vector art digitizes without redrawing, which keeps setup fast
PMS number for each color, plus a name for odd shades
Thread is matched to Pantone, not to a screen image
Counts per size and per colorway
Sizing drives the fabric cut and the price tier
Street, contact name, phone, and ZIP
Freight and DDP eligibility depend on it
Your in-hands date, not the ship date
It decides whether production and sea freight fit at all

blocks.text: Add the quantity per colorway and any decoration requirement, because puff, patches, and print each change both the unit price and the lead time.

sections.h2: How do deposits, QC, and balance payment work?

blocks.text: You pay a deposit to start production and the balance after QC photos, before the goods ship. That order of events protects you: money changes hands twice, and the second payment only follows evidence that the caps are right.

A common arrangement is 30% deposit and 70% before dispatch, though terms vary. Raymark accepts T/T, Alibaba Trade Assurance, and PayPal for samples; there is no card checkout, so every order starts with a [quote request](/contact/).
Good QC photos show the front logo, a full cap, the interior label, the closure, and one cap from each colorway. If logo size is critical, ask for a ruler in the frame.

blocks.title: Do not skip the photo step
blocks.text: Paying the full balance before you see production photos removes your only leverage if a color or logo size is wrong. Ask for photos of every colorway, not one representative cap.

sections.h2: Which shipping method should you choose?

blocks.text: Choose express for small or urgent orders, air for mid-size orders, and sea for anything over a few hundred caps that can wait. Compare landed cost, unit price plus freight per cap, rather than unit price alone.
DDP door delivery is available, so freight can be quoted to your address rather than a port. Ask for DDP quotes at the same quantity and address.

sections.h2: How do reorders work, and what changes on the second run?

blocks.text: Reorders skip artwork and sampling, so they start production sooner and price at the new quantity tier. The design, digitizing, and thread colors are already on file.

items: Send the original order number, or the artwork and approved Pantone list
Confirm the same fabric and thread colors, since dye lots can shift slightly between runs
Expect 12-18 days of production and the same shipping choices.

blocks.title: Ask for a first-cap photo
blocks.text: On a reorder the fabric may come from a new dye lot. One photo of the first finished cap catches a shade shift before the whole run is sewn.

faqs.q: How long does production take after I approve the proof?
faqs.a: 12-18 days for bulk orders, or 18-25 days in peak season, plus shipping time. The clock starts once the deposit clears.

faqs.q: Do I pay the full amount up front?
faqs.a: No. A deposit starts production and the balance is due after you approve QC photos, before dispatch.

faqs.q: Can I ship to more than one address?
faqs.a: Yes, but each destination is a separate shipment with its own freight quote, and splitting usually raises the freight cost per cap.

faqs.q: What if I have a fixed event date?
faqs.a: Say so before the quote. The in-hands date decides whether express fits, and it is the one detail that changes the whole schedule.
Yes. Raymark keeps artwork confidential and does not reuse your logo on other orders.
